name: Costa a Costa
description: '''Costa a Costa''' was a Brazilian rap and hip hop group that was created in 2005 in [[Fortaleza]], [[Ceará]]. In 2007, they released the mixtape ''Dinheiro, Sexo, Drogas e Violência de Costa a Costa'', through the independent label DuNego, created by the members of the group. The work sold thousands of self-made copies, received critical and media recognition and influenced a new generation of rappers in the country.
